blocks.html: Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), the newest addition to Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center’s partner government agencies, recently opened its Mobile Extension Services kiosks in Robinsons Galleria Ortigas and Robinsons Place Manila. PRC is the Philippine government’s arm which ensures the country with reliable, trustworthy and progressive system of determining valid and credible licensure examinations and globally-recognized standards for professional practice. Its Mobile Extension Services kiosks offer renewal of Professional Identification Card (PIC) and application for Licensure Examination for Accountancy, Civil Engineering, Dentistry, Geodetic Engineering, Interior Design, Medical Technology, Medicine, Nursing, Optometry, Psychology, Teacher, and Real Estate Broker among others. The mobile kiosks are located at Lower Level, Park Avenue at Robinsons Galleria Ortigas, and Level 3, Lower Level Foodcourt, Adriatico Wing at Robinsons Place Manila. These kiosks are open on weekdays from 10 AM – 6 PM. Applicants for licensure examinations shall accomplish an online form via www.prc.gov.ph and bring with them the necessary requirements on the appointment date. Professionals who will renew their PIC need to accomplish a renewal form, pay the prescribed fee and claim their PIC on the same day. Upcoming PRC satellite offices will be opening soon in Robinsons Place Santiago, Robinsons Place Bacolod, Robinsons Place Iloilo, Robinsons Place Dumaguete, Robinsons Place Tacloban, Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Robinsons Place GenSan, and Robinsons Place Butuan. Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center is a public service program of Robinsons Land Corporation.It is the Philippines’ first and biggest shopping center facility that brings together all the government agencies most relevant to the communities where Robinsons Malls are located. To date, there are 30 Lingkod Pinoy Centers nationwide with nineteen (19) participating government agencies. There will be seven (7) more Lingkod Pinoy Centers to open in Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Place Jaro, Robinsons Place Iligan, Robinsons Place Naga, Robinsons Place Tuguegarao, Robinsons Place Tacloban, and Robinsons Place Valencia.
